objects.name: Analytic 1878
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a file written to an Industrial Control System (ICS) host from a remote network share, where the file has an executable or script extension, immediately followed by execution of that file from the same path. Documented in the PIPEDREAM toolkit's modular design, where components transfer files to compromised Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs) and engineering workstations. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.
